sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Dify is a platform for building AI apps without starting from scratch. On one visual interface you get AI workflows, RAG pipelines for your documents, agents, model management and observability, and every app comes with an API you can call from your own software.
sixtySeconds.problem: Going from an AI prototype to a production app means wiring up models, document search, prompts, monitoring and APIs. Dify brings these together so teams can build, test and ship LLM apps faster.
whoFor: Product teams building AI chat and workflow apps
Developers who want a backend-as-a-service for LLM apps
Companies building RAG on internal documents
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an all-in-one, self-hostable LLM app platform with visual workflows and APIs. Check the Dify Open Source License, which adds conditions to Apache 2.0.
requirements: CPU with 2+ cores and 4 GiB+ RAM
Docker with a running daemon and Docker Compose v2.35.0+

overview: Dify combines a workflow canvas, a prompt IDE, RAG pipelines with text extraction from PDFs, slides and other documents, autonomous agents with their own sandbox, and LLMOps monitoring. It supports hundreds of proprietary and open models from dozens of providers, including any OpenAI API-compatible model.

Every Dify app exposes APIs, so it works as a backend-as-a-service for your own products. Agents can run commands, install software and handle files in a sandbox, and can use tools from the Dify Marketplace.

You can use Dify Cloud, self-host the Community Edition with Docker Compose, or ask about Dify Enterprise for SSO, RBAC and support SLAs. Self-hosting needs a generated auth token in the .env file before the first start.
